periods.time: vol-10 ch-002, night after the third round

name.zh: 一辉以纸斩铁并与史黛菈约定准决赛
name.en: Ikki cuts with paper and Stella promises the semifinal

periods.summary: Ikki trains to refine his imitation of Edelweiss's silent sword by cutting wood and iron pipes with sheets of paper, trying to remove all wasted motion and account for external disturbances. Stella joins him, and Ikki thanks her for saving Shizuku. He says he understands Shizuku's feelings and will settle the account with Amane. Stella demonstrates the immense strength gained from Nene's training by throwing a paper ball through an iron pipe and into concrete, then promises to defeat Ouma and wait for Ikki in the final.
periods.cause: Ikki prepares for Amane while Stella prepares for Ouma after Shizuku's attack and humiliation.
periods.outcome: Both reaffirm their path to the final; Stella's new power is foreshadowed and Ikki remains awake to guard against Amane's luck.
periods.significance: Links Ikki's technical refinement and Stella's new raw power immediately before the two semifinals.
